# BCGov Crow - v0.14.1

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow adds routed application diagnostics guidance that helps teams give users
clear, actionable error messages while retaining useful, access-controlled
diagnostic context for operators.

## Highlights

- Guide teams to present validation, access, unavailable-resource, and service
  failures on the least disruptive appropriate surface, with accessible,
  persistent support references where needed.
- Provide a shared baseline for safe error responses, support-reference
  correlation, structured logging, and verification of deployed diagnostics.

## Changes

- Added a reusable application-diagnostics module and .NET and Java companion
  guidance, routed from application development, B.C. UX, testing, security
  remediation, and architecture review.
- Expanded the architecture review template with operational verification for
  readiness, log-sink delivery, support-reference lookup, and trace propagation.
- Clarified security-review guidance for exceptional, time-limited sensitive
  diagnostic logging and its required safeguards.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.14.1 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.14.1.zip --global --target copilot
```
